title: Record the central triple six-call floor
body:
## Summary
- The target corner is a symmetric 6-by-6 matrix of rank 6, and its 3-bit halves are the three coordinate vectors.
- Complementary coefficients `1` and `w` add their subspace ranks, and rank-nullity in dimensions 5 and 6 leaves no room for five calls to carry two ranks of 3.
- The X calls and the Y calls each number at least 6. No new kappa, and shorter words are not searched.
